mapper.sql: PAYOUT_ID, SRC_TYPE, SRC_NO, CONTRACT_NO, PAY_AMT, BANK_CD, ACCOUNT_MASK, HOLDER_NM, STAT_CD, TRACE_NO, SEND_COUNT, INQUIRY_COUNT, NEXT_TRY_DT, RESULT_CD, RESULT_MSG, REQ_EMP_ID, REQ_DT, SENT_DT, DONE_DT
mapper.select: SELECT CONTRACT_NO, TOTAL_PAY_AMT AS AMOUNT FROM TB_CLM WHERE CLM_NO = #{clmNo} AND CLM_STAT_CD = '40' AND TOTAL_PAY_AMT > 0
SELECT CONTRACT_NO, REFUND_AMT AS AMOUNT FROM TB_CTR_MILEAGE WHERE CONTRACT_NO = #{contractNo} AND MIL_STAT_CD = '20' AND REFUND_AMT > 0
SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM TB_PAY_OUT WHERE SRC_TYPE = #{srcType} AND SRC_NO = #{srcNo} AND STAT_CD <> '80')
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TB_PAY_OUT (SRC_TYPE, SRC_NO, CONTRACT_NO, PAY_AMT, BANK_CD, ACCOUNT_ENC, ACCOUNT_MASK, HOLDER_NM, STAT_CD, TRACE_NO, NEXT_TRY_DT, REQ_EMP_ID, REQ_DT, GLOBAL_TX_ID) VALUES (#{srcType}, #{srcNo}, #{contractNo}, #{payAmt}, #{bankCd}, #{accountEnc}, #{accountMask}, #{holderNm}, '10', #{traceNo}, #{now}, #{reqEmpId}, #{now}, #{globalTxId})
mapper.select: SELECT PAYOUT_ID, STAT_CD, BANK_CD, ACCOUNT_ENC, PAY_AMT, HOLDER_NM, TRACE_NO, SEND_COUNT, INQUIRY_COUNT, SRC_TYPE FROM TB_PAY_OUT WHERE STAT_CD IN ('10', '70') AND NEXT_TRY_DT <= #{now} ORDER BY NEXT_TRY_DT, PAYOUT_ID LIMIT 1 FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED
